notes.title: Update 1.3 - Splitscreen Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Exciting news for Targets! We've added a 2-player co-op split-screen mode, just in time for Steam's Couch Co-Op Festival. Grab a friend and two controllers to tackle the action together!

This feature took a bit longer to implement than I initially expected—but as they say, "I didn't do it because it was easy; I did it because I thought it would be easy." 😅

The demo has been updated too with the new co-op mode, so dive in and let us know what you think!"

notes.title: Targets: the first update!
notes.notes:
"Targets" has now been updated for the first time!

The game will now auto-save your progress every minute and every time you pick a Coin, so you can dive back into the world of "Targets" from where you left off, without losing your hard-earned progress!

The number of coins you need to unlock sprint has been reduced from 30 to 25 so you can look for the last coins and targets all across the map in record time.
There are now some clues in the game about the location of the 35 coins. 

You can now use the "B" key to turn Motion Blur On/Off during gameplay. Some players prefer motion blur off but keeping it On (as default) may help the game look smoother on some hardware. 

There's also other minor small tweaks that hopefully will improve the experience. 

Next planned update: lvl2
